correctness.rationale: Independent construction of the complete nine-real-coordinate no-click Lindblad generator gives det L=-(2g+1)(4g^3+4g^2+9g+2)/2 and exactly the claimed rational mean for all g>=0 and Δ real, not just sample values. Differentiation yields F'=-2(8g^4+8g^3-2g^2+7)/Q^2<0 and F''=4(2g+3)P/Q^3>0. Independently verified Bernstein coefficients [21,114/5,141/5,501/20,6/5,66] on 0<=g<=3/2 and shifted coefficients [66,216,394,324,120,16] for g>=3/2 prove P>0. Thus strict convexity, derivative signs at g=0 and infinity, unique positive global minimizer, d g*/d z>0, and g*(z)/sqrt(z)->1. Finite-dimensional CP trace-decaying semigroup has no nonzero dark invariant positive state, so the integral equals -L^{-1}P2 even at zero dephasing; this is an analytic proof, not solely verifier success.
residual_risks: No theorem for general κ/J, four or more sites, arbitrary off-diagonal noise normalization, capture-time tails or interacting excitations.

value.rationale: A central initial excitation and central detuning form a natural extension of the known clean-middle transport setup. The exact single-parameter all-detuning convexity and monotone noise-control law are nontrivial because the detuning correction has a degree-three rational denominator and a degree-five global positivity certificate. A useful exact robust optimizer for matched extraction is not merely a reparameterization of an earlier source-end result. The three-site restricted scope and priority risks are explicitly retained.
residual_risks: This finite idealized Markovian model is not a general laboratory design law; arbitrary sink coupling is unproved.
